{{Quote|When the ''Brazen'' is minimally operational, it will jump to a fully-equipped Imperial Navy shipyard, most probably the deepdock facility that's in towards the Metharian Nebula.|[[Melvor Khamp]]|<ref name="OE">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>}}
The '''Metharian Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Metharian Nebula Territories]], a region that contained the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]<ref name="OE" /> and the [[Tantra system/Legends|Tantra system]].<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

[[File:Metharian_Nebula_Territories.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Metharian Nebula shared its name with the Metharian Nebula Territories]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]'' was severely [[Ambush near the Degan Gas Clouds|damaged]] near the [[Degan Gas Clouds]] by the [[Khuiumin Survivors]]. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] managed to escape the battle and went to [[Derilyn]] to receive temporary repairs on its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] at the facilities of the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]]. The plan was to perform limited repairs on the Star Destroyer so that it would be able to reach a fully-equipped [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], most probably a [[Deepdock/Legends|deepdock]] facility located towards the Metharian Nebula. However, the ''Brazen'' was [[Battle of Derilyn|destroyed]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who infiltrated the Derilyn Space Defense Platform.<ref name="OE" />
